content: <thought>We need to construct a hierarchical retrosynthesis route using the three templates and their precursor lists. The target molecule is the product from template 324324 (the SMILES after “>>” in its mapped reaction). Template 324324 breaks the target into two precursors; the first precursor is further broken by template 1914396 into an aldehyde‑sulfonamide and malonic acid. The aldehyde‑sulfonamide is then broken by template 733 into a chlorosulfonyl‑benzaldehyde and an aniline. The second precursor from the first step has no further disconnections.
